title: Let praise loosen your need to grasp
summary: The Lord's power can be praised, but never possessed or contained. Return the hand to trust before it closes again.
takeaway: Return the hand to trust before it closes again.
lifeApplication: Before tightening around the outcome again, stop, name what is already here, and release one demand you cannot faithfully carry.

source.shortMeaning: The Lord's power can be praised, but never possessed or contained.
source.lifeApplication: When control tightens, answer first with praise instead of mastery.
